newsitem.title: LEBANON: Six wounded in clash in Lebanon refugee camp.
newsitem.headline: Six wounded in clash in Lebanon refugee camp.

text.p: Six people were wounded on Wednesday in a gun battle in a south Lebanon refugee camp between rival Palestinian fighters, security sources said.

They said the afternoon fighting took place in Ain el-Hilweh refugee camp near the port of Sidon between Mahmoud Mustapha, the deputy chief of a small militant Palestinian group, and members of the Saadi clan who are PLO guerrillas.

Mustapha, known by his nom-de-guerre Abu Obaidah, was severly wounded and taken to a hospital inside the camp. Three members of the Saadi clan and two women were also wounded in the firefight in which AK-47 assault rifles were used.
The clash took place after Abu Obaidah tried to solve an old dispute with the rivals, the sources said.

Both Abu Obaidah and his chief Abu Mohjen, who heads the small faction Osbet al-Ansar (Band of Supporters), are wanted by Lebanese authorities on charges of planning bombings in a number of Lebanese cities. Abu Mohjen is still at large.
